system.description:
Your bodies biology rapidly reconfigures into a more defensive state, allowing you to resist harmful effects and even shrug off very damaging assaults.

When this jutsu is cast, select one Damage type or condition you’ve experienced this initiative. For the duration you gain resistance to the chosen damage or condition.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is Cast at A-Rank, you can instead select any combination of Damage types or conditions you’ve experience, up to two, gaining resistance to them for the duration.
